records.recommendation: Confirm that this record is Constellation Project 1, the 150 MW option, and that the two projects are meant to be separate records.
records.researcher_notes: The order calls the 150 MW plant Project 1 and the 564 MW plant Project 2. They are two alternative proposals for the same area near the Perryman Generating Station in Harford County. News reports say Constellation offered them as a menu of options, so only one may be built. Because the order redacts site details, the exact location is unknown.

records.recommendation: Consider whether the start year of 2029 should be entered while the project is only announced.

records.recommendation: Check the equipment model against a second document before entering it.
records.researcher_notes: A Power Engineering profile of Panda Brandywine says the plant has two GE Frame 7EA gas turbines, two Nooter Eriksen heat recovery steam generators and a GE condensing steam turbine, with commercial operation on October 31, 1996. I read this on the page myself, but the site blocks the checking tool. So the equipment is a lead and not a confirmed value. records.recommendation: No action. Do not confuse this plant with the nearby Keys Energy Center.
records.researcher_notes: News coverage of the December 2025 Maryland fast-track process calls the Alpha Generation upgrade proposal a Brandywine project. The Public Service Commission order names it as the Keys Energy Center, a separate plant. So I did not attach that proposal to this plant.

records.recommendation: Check whether SGT1 belongs to this plant.

It sits on the same site at the same coordinates. Ownership for this unit may differ from the other six units.
